history.summary: Large 1399 sqft 99yr 3BR at Sanctuary Green (D15), 240m / 3-min walk to Tanjong Rhu MRT (TE23), at $2.28M / $1630 PSF — bang on the $1650 district median. Excellent TEL connectivity and a 4.69% resale CAGR over a deep 109-txn series make this a credible, if unspectacular, RCR hold.
history.rating_rationale: Strong on the metrics that matter: 240m to a TEL station, 4.69% URA resale CAGR backed by 109 transactions (high confidence), large established development with deep liquidity, and $2.28M sits in the prime buyer-pool band. Entry at $1630 PSF is at-median, so no discount, and it's a 2003 99yr lease (~76yr left) which caps long-run upside — but the location, data quality and quantum make it a solid investment.
red_flags: 2003 99yr lease (~76yr remaining) — lease decay starts to matter on a 5-7yr hold's exit
